raw_prompt: Build a secure payment processing service.

cumulative_requirements.title: Secure Payment Processing
cumulative_requirements.description: The system must process payments securely.

cumulative_requirements.title: Idempotent Transaction Handling
cumulative_requirements.description: Payment requests must utilize idempotency keys to prevent duplicate charges upon network retries.
cumulative_requirements.justification: Why 1: Network failures cause retries that risk double-charging customers. Why 2: Idempotency keys bound to transaction payloads enforce single-execution guarantees at the gateway layer. Why 3: Zero tolerance for financial discrepancies due to network instability.

cumulative_requirements.title: Data Encryption in Transit and at Rest
cumulative_requirements.description: All sensitive financial data and payment credentials must be encrypted using industry-standard cryptographic algorithms.
cumulative_requirements.justification: Why 1: Financial data is high-value target for interception and theft. Why 2: Implementing TLS for transport and AES-256 for storage neutralizes exposure vectors. Why 3: Regulatory compliance and asset protection mandates absolute confidentiality of payment payloads.

cumulative_requirements.title: Undefined Payment Gateway Provider
cumulative_requirements.description: The specific third-party payment processor, acquiring bank, or rail (e.g., Stripe, ACH, SWIFT) is unspecified.
cumulative_requirements.justification: The prompt does not state which external providers or payment rails the service must interface with.

cumulative_requirements.title: Undefined User Interfaces and Dashboards
cumulative_requirements.description: No merchant onboarding web UIs, customer billing dashboards, or frontend interfaces are specified or required.
cumulative_requirements.justification: Anti-hallucination barrier prohibits generating unrequested UI pages or frontend dashboards.

cumulative_requirements.title: Atomic State Transition Guard for Ledger Settlement
cumulative_requirements.description: The payment processing service must enforce strict transactional atomicity and state machine guards (e.g., Pending -> Authorized -> Captured -> Settled / Failed) to prevent double-spending or unauthorized intermediate state updates.
cumulative_requirements.provenance: Double-entry bookkeeping and financial transaction integrity principles
cumulative_requirements.justification: Step 1: Financial ledgers require strict state machine transitions to prevent concurrent updates from moving a transaction from 'Failed' back to 'Authorized'. Step 2: Without explicit database-level isolation and state transition guards, race conditions under heavy load can lead to unverified state corruption or ledger imbalances. Step 3: Therefore, an atomic state transition invariant must be enforced at the database and application boundary to guarantee data integrity.

cumulative_requirements.title: Webhook Delivery Retry and Poison Message Isolation
cumulative_requirements.description: The system must guarantee reliable asynchronous webhook notifications for payment lifecycle events using an exponential backoff retry mechanism, coupled with a dead-letter queue (DLQ) for poison messages exceeding maximum retry attempts.
cumulative_requirements.provenance: Distributed systems and asynchronous event-driven architecture standards
cumulative_requirements.justification: Step 1: Payment processors must asynchronously notify downstream systems of state changes (e.g., charge success/failure). Step 2: Unreliable network conditions or failing downstream endpoints can cause message loss or endless retry loops that exhaust system resources. Step 3: Therefore, implementing bounded exponential backoff retries with dead-letter isolation is necessary to maintain system resilience and prevent processing bottlenecks.

cumulative_requirements.title: Cryptographic Audit Trail and Non-Repudiation Logging
cumulative_requirements.description: All payment request payloads, authorization tokens, state transitions, and cryptographic verification receipts must be logged to an append-only, tamper-evident audit log to ensure non-repudiation and regulatory compliance.
cumulative_requirements.provenance: PCI-DSS compliance and financial audit requirements
cumulative_requirements.justification: Step 1: Financial systems are subject to strict auditing and dispute resolution (chargebacks, fraud investigations). Step 2: Standard application logs can be altered or lack cryptographic chaining, failing to prove that transaction records were unmodified over time. Step 3: Therefore, an append-only audit trail with cryptographic integrity checks is mandatory to provide non-repudiation for all financial transactions.

cumulative_requirements.title: Graceful Shutdown and Crash Recovery Invariant
cumulative_requirements.description: The payment processing service must handle SIGTERM/SIGINT signals by completing in-flight atomic ledger operations or safely rolling back uncommitted local transactions, ensuring zero partial state corruption upon abrupt power loss or container termination.
cumulative_requirements.justification: Required for financial transactional integrity during infrastructure autoscaling, deployments, or abrupt container termination.

cumulative_requirements.title: PCI-DSS Scope Minimization and Tokenization Boundary
cumulative_requirements.description: The system architecture must enforce a strict boundary preventing raw Primary Account Numbers (PAN) and Card Verification Values (CVV) from persisting in internal databases, mandating immediate tokenization via an external vault or compliant token service provider.
cumulative_requirements.justification: Statutory regulatory requirement for handling cardholder data securely and minimizing PCI compliance boundaries.

cumulative_requirements.title: Undefined Storage Engine and Database Technology
cumulative_requirements.description: The specific relational database management system, NoSQL store, or distributed consensus ledger backing the transaction state machine and append-only audit log is unspecified.
cumulative_requirements.justification: Unstated technology choice in original prompt regarding persistent data layers.

cumulative_requirements.title: Undefined Cryptographic Token and Authentication Identity Provider
cumulative_requirements.description: The identity provider (IdP), OAuth2/OIDC issuer, or cryptographic token format (e.g., PASETO, JWT) used for authenticating API callers and merchants is unstated.
cumulative_requirements.justification: Unstated operational and security mechanism for service-to-service and client authentication.

cumulative_requirements.title: Undefined Network Transport and API Protocol
cumulative_requirements.description: The explicit network protocol (e.g., gRPC, REST/JSON over HTTP/2, GraphQL) and message serialization formats for external and internal service communication remain unspecified.
cumulative_requirements.justification: Unstated technology choice for interface communication boundaries.
